description: Document-level relevance judgements written from verified abstracts, tables of contents and front matter. They were NOT derived from page text and may be wrong; review them and add page-level annotations (relevant_pages) after reading the documents.

queries.query: Which field crops tolerate deficit irrigation without large yield losses?
queries.relevance_basis: The report summary names cotton, maize, groundnut, wheat, sunflower and sugar beet as less sensitive to stress.

queries.query: yield response factor ky relating relative yield loss to relative evapotranspiration deficit
queries.relevance_basis: IDDP 66 covers the FAO water production function; Water Reports 22 has a chapter on yield response factors.

queries.query: How does supplemental irrigation stabilise yields of rainfed crops during dry spells?
queries.relevance_basis: Both ICARDA records are about supplemental irrigation for rainfed crops; the 2018 abstract describes alleviating dry-spell moisture stress.

queries.query: critical crop growth stages for applying limited irrigation water to rainfed wheat
queries.relevance_basis: The 2018 abstract states supplemental irrigation during critical growth stages improves yield and water productivity.

queries.query: pro-active drought risk management policy instead of crisis response in the Near East and North Africa
queries.relevance_basis: The report abstract calls for a paradigm shift to pro-active drought management planning in the region.

queries.query: which North African countries have national drought management plans
queries.relevance_basis: The report reviews drought policies country by country, including Morocco.

queries.query: how to compute the Standardized Precipitation Index by fitting a gamma distribution
queries.relevance_basis: The WMO SPI User Guide describes the SPI calculation.

queries.query: recommended minimum length of the precipitation record for calculating SPI
queries.relevance_basis: The WMO SPI User Guide gives data-length recommendations.

queries.query: land surface reanalysis forced by atmospheric fields at 9 km resolution
queries.relevance_basis: The ERA5-Land article describes the dataset, its forcing and resolution.

queries.query: gridded rainfall dataset blending satellite estimates with rain gauge stations since 1981
queries.relevance_basis: The article documents CHIRPS version 3, a station-blended satellite precipitation dataset.

queries.query: AquaCrop simulation model of crop water productivity
queries.relevance_basis: The IDDP 66 table of contents has a part on the AquaCrop simulation model.

queries.query: regulated deficit irrigation of grapevines and fruit trees
queries.relevance_basis: Water Reports 22 has chapters on fruit trees and grapevines; IDDP 66 has guidelines for fruit trees and vines.

queries.query: irrigation de complément pour stabiliser les rendements du blé pluvial
queries.relevance_basis: French paraphrase of q03; the documents are in English, so this tests cross-lingual retrieval.

queries.query: gestion proactive de la sécheresse en Afrique du Nord
queries.relevance_basis: French paraphrase of q05; the document is in English.
